intro: The Warsong Runner Update is a military dispatch carrying situational observations from the Zoram'gar Outpost along the western coast of Ashenvale. Delivered to the Horde commander Kadrak at the Barrens border, it helps coordinate the Warsong clan's ongoing campaign against the night elves.

p: Positioned at the edge of the Zoram Strand, the Warsong runner at Zoram'gar Outpost keeps watch over coastal waters and nearby threats in western Ashenvale. This update contains critical intelligence gathered from the outpost's frontline scouts, documenting regional activity and securing supply lines. Carried back to Kadrak's watchtower on the Barrens border, the dispatch provides the Horde leadership with the clarity needed to fortify their position and plan subsequent movements deep in ancestral elven woods.
